prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished 4:3 landscape cover illustration for the FC Tortalona project in a portfolio grid. Render a full-bleed 1536x1152 composition, designed to remain legible at 440x330 pixels.
Create an exquisite vintage football matchday programme cover in the style of a mid-century engraved European football souvenir certificate. Warm pale ivory paper, deep royal blue ink (#15375b and #315d91), blue-and-ivory striped fabric, restrained antique gold (#ae833e). Beautiful fine copperplate crosshatching and stipple, subtle age and paper grain, precise printmaking rather than a digital painting.
Composition: a slim engraved royal-blue floral border with fine gold inner rules encloses the full rectangular image. Across the top is a shallow striped blue-and-ivory curtain swag with delicate gold fringe, pinned by two gold corner rosettes. Short fabric tails fall only down the upper third of each side, leaving the main artwork unobscured. This is theatre-like football pageantry, elegant and balanced, with room for the central scene.
In the open centre, set the exact words "FC TORTALONA" in a large beautiful tall high-contrast antique serif, on one gently arched line. Below the title set the exact tagline "Pasión, Pan, y Pelota" in smaller elegant italic serif. Ensure exact accents and spelling. All type is deep blue ink, integrated as real letterpress.
Below this lettering, the principal illustration is a handsome oversized old-fashioned stitched leather soccer ball in warm antique golden ochre and deep-blue engraved shadow, resting on a football pitch. Behind it is a low, graceful engraved view of a soccer goal with a fine net and quiet vintage stadium terraces, in delicate blue hatching fading into ivory. The ball is the clear focal point, with exquisite leather seams. A small laurel branch can frame the lower corners. Keep the background quiet so the cover reads immediately.
Balanced, refined, collectible, old sporting club dignity with warmth and personality. The overall image must feel like the same world as a light ivory, blue, gold vintage soccer leaderboard framed by engraved curtains. Entire border and curtain corners visible with generous inset, no tight cropping.
No shields, no club crest, no other logos, no scoreboards or player data, no invented founding dates, no additional words, no UI, no website screenshot, no modern black-and-white soccer-ball pattern, no photographic render, no green field, no red, no gradients, no glow.
